notes.title: Patch 1.31 Released
notes.notes:
🌿 Hello, Wildrise Rangers!
We're back with another exciting update packed with improvements based on your valuable feedback, plus essential bugfixes to enhance your restoration experience!
✨ Improvements & Polish
🏞️ Enhanced Mana Bomb Power! - Floofi's Mana Bomb is now truly devastating! Watch as it destroys a massive 3x3 grid of tiles, making cleanup faster and more satisfying than ever

🎒 Power-Up Persistence - Great news for newcomers! You can now carry your precious Wildflowers and Mana Bombs forward to the next level on Easy and Normal difficulties. Don't worry, hardcore players - Hard and Impossible modes remain the ultimate test of skill with no safety nets!

🌸 Improved Power-Up Earning System - We've rebalanced the rate how you earn Wildflowers and Mana Bombs that now scales appropriately with difficulty levels
🐛 Bugfixes
🔊 Audio System Overhaul - We've resolved the Alt+Tab audio issues that were sometimes disrupting your peaceful restoration sessions

⚡ Performance Optimization - Faster loading times on start means you can jump back into nature restoration without delay
[hr][/hr]
Happy restoring, and thank you for helping us make Wildrise even better! 🌱

Keep the feedback coming - we're always listening to our amazing community of Rangers!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Released! 🌿Massive Expansion: 14 New Levels + Impossible Difficulty
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609449/0db573ba3fabf8e901ce725e5f466f2c3618b127.jpg"]
🌿 Hello, Nature Restorers!
It's our biggest update yet! We're adding 14 new levels, multiple monitor support, an Impossible difficulty for the ultimate challenge, and LOTS of bugfixes! Please find the patch notes below.
🆕 New Content & Features
🏞️ 14 Brand New Levels - Increasing the total to 24 levels with multiple hidden treasures. Can you complete our most challenging levels yet?

😈 Impossible Difficulty - For those seeking the ultimate challenge and highest scores:

Reduced rainbow piece spawn chances

Wildflowers and bombs become extremely rare

No helpful game mechanics when you're stuck - you're completely on your own!

🖥️ Multiple Monitor Support - You can now select your primary monitor in Options → Resolutions

🇬🇷 Greek Language Support - Καλώς ήρθατε στο Wildrise!
🐛 Bugfixes
🔊 Audio Improvements

Reworked audio bus with improved volume interpolation

Nature soundscape no longer continues when you Alt+Tab

🖥️ Display & UI Fixes

Fixed several multiple monitor issues

Resolved options panel issues - buttons are clickable everywhere again

Updated win level panel with reordered buttons

🌍 Translation & Localization

Fixed translation issues across several languages

⚖️ Gameplay Balance

Rebalanced level progression and piece probability calculations
✨ Improvements & Polish
🎬 Animation Fixes - Smoother animations and performance optimizations

🐾 Floofi Enhancement - Our adorable companion now responds when you try to pet him!
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon
Thank you for your feedback and support! We're currently working on:

Enhanced animations and visual effects

Story intro that plays when you launch the game

Even more exciting content based on your suggestions!

Happy restoring! 🌱

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609449/38a44f09524e64911ab262ccc25e53b38eb45bf4.gif

Hello Floofi-fans!

We are releasing a bigger patch this time, containing several adjustments to the scoring, difficulty and other mechanics from the feedback that we have received from your nature adventure. You can also see the part of the creation process of our animation for the main character - it's all hard work and we hope you like it!

Please find the patch notes below.

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue with music and sound not stopping when the game loses focus
 Fixed a rare issue with discard not correctly showing the piece that is being discarded
 Some translations fixes have been implemented thanks to player feedback
 The order of background unlocks and pieces has been adjusted and rebalanced
 The winning of the level now correctly shows the winning screen even without waiting for a click after 3 seconds have passed
 Music now correctly switches tracks when doing main menu and level transitions for a better listening experience



Improvements

 An option to restart a level has been added. It is only available on the Easy and Medium difficulties but it would allow you to restart the level if you get completely stuck. This won't work on Hard or .. another.. even harder difficulty that's coming soon, so use it but know that you can only rely on your wits if you want to achieve the highest score!
 Game Tutorial has been updated to provide even more information on how to achieve success in Wildrise
 There's a new and awesome animation of Floofi sleeping in the leaderboard. Check it out!
 The difficulties have been rebalanced and adjusted. They provide more points but each difficulty is now harder than the previous, so be strong of hard if you want to beat the Imposs.. the secret difficulty that's coming soon, hehe



Thank you for your feedback! We are hoping to bring more levels and cute animations in the next game update, stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609449/0b774d0919e9c6f5113612da534553e1de2ddd39.png

Wildrise has received it's very first patch! Much more to come as we go along our journey in restoring nature

This patch contains several bugfixes, difficulty rebalancing and improved main menu music track

Please find the patch notes below.

Bugfixes

 Save system has been revamped and optimized, it now correctly stores all game states and UI is properly updated on load
 Rainbow tiles now spawn correctly according to the chosen game difficulty
 Grass decorations now properly persist between game sessions
 Animations have been optimized and game size slightly reduced
 Floofi sad animation now includes tears. Please don't make him sad :(


Improvements

 Game difficulty has now been rebalanced and hard difficulty is truly hard, not for the faint of heart!
 Translations have been improved thanks to the feedback of our players
 Our composer has improved the main music theme to make it even more beautiful


Thank you for your feedback! The team is working on bringing more exciting adventures with Floofi!
